# HELP acmeserve:num_requests_running Requests being served now.
acmeserve:num_requests_running 2
# HELP acmeserve:requests_running The same count under a second name.
acmeserve:requests_running 2
# HELP acmeserve:num_requests_waiting Requests in the queue.
acmeserve:num_requests_waiting 1
# HELP acmeserve:kv_cache_usage_perc Share of each cache slot in use, from 0 to 1.
acmeserve:kv_cache_usage_perc{slot="0"} 0.25
acmeserve:kv_cache_usage_perc{slot="1"} 0.5
# HELP acmeserve:generation_tokens_total Output tokens, counted when a request ends.
acmeserve:generation_tokens_total 20000
# HELP acmeserve:scheduler_tokens_total Tokens counted while a request is in progress, one series per mode.
acmeserve:scheduler_tokens_total{mode="prefill"} 410000
acmeserve:scheduler_tokens_total{mode="decode"} 21000
# HELP acmeserve:prompt_tokens_total Input tokens, counted when a request ends.
acmeserve:prompt_tokens_total 400000
# HELP acmeserve:cached_prompt_tokens_total Input tokens read from a cache.
acmeserve:cached_prompt_tokens_total 90000
# HELP acmeserve:preemptions_total Requests paused to make room for another.
acmeserve:preemptions_total 3
# HELP acmeserve:time_to_first_token_seconds Wait before the first output token.
acmeserve:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{le="0.25"} 10
acmeserve:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{le="0.5"} 20
acmeserve:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{le="1"} 30
acmeserve:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{le="2.5"} 36
acmeserve:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{le="5"} 39
acmeserve:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{le="+Inf"} 40
acmeserve:time_to_first_token_seconds_sum 30
acmeserve:time_to_first_token_seconds_count 40
# HELP acmeserve:requests_finished_total Requests answered since the start.
acmeserve:requests_finished_total 40
# HELP acmeserve:device_memory_bytes Accelerator memory in use.
acmeserve:device_memory_bytes 68719476736
# HELP acmeserve:engine_parked Whether the model is unloaded: 1 if so.
acmeserve:engine_parked 0
# HELP acmeserve:server_info Describes this server in its labels.
acmeserve:server_info{model="example-model",version="0.0.0",instance="example-instance"} 1
# HELP acmeserve:process_start_time_seconds Start of the process, in Unix seconds.
acmeserve:process_start_time_seconds 1700000000
# HELP process_open_fds Open file descriptors.
